name: realy-mcp
description: Read-only analysis of CSV tables uploaded to your Realy account.

interface.longDescription: Realy Data Analytics helps you explore CSV tables uploaded to your Realy account. Discover available tables and columns, and ask data questions using filtering, sorting, aggregations and joins using structured read-only operations. Results include typed rows and operation traces. Access is limited to the signed-in user's authorized data. The tools do not modify source records, browse the web, train models or produce forecasts. A Realy account with uploaded data is required.
interface.defaultPrompt: What tables are available, and what questions can I ask about them?

positive.description: Sign in using the credentials supplied securely in Reviewer credentials. Both CSVs are saved in the existing conversation titled "How many rows are in each of the two uploaded tables?" under Recent conversations. No upload is required. Connect the MCP using the same demo account. Discover scope and select that conversation; use the exact table names and conversation_id returned by scope. Tables: Biochemistry_Proteins (protein_id, protein_name, gene, organism) and Biochemistry_Protein_Properties (protein_id, length_aa, mass_da, ec_numbers), 20 rows each. These are complementary UniProt demo tables, not patient data. Discover the preloaded demo tables.
positive.prompt: What tables and columns are available in the biochemistry demo conversation?
positive.expected_behavior: Call realy_describe_scope. Identify both tables and their four columns listed above. If scope supplies row counts, report 20 for each; do not invent counts absent from scope. No retrieval is needed for schema discovery.

Report actual returned results; a service error is not a passed test. Do not fabricate trace links.
